definition.semantic_compatibility: K_e(q), frozen-embedding relation and role compatibility

channels.simplex: support, contradict, unknown and related epistemic state

invariants: local routing probabilities sum to one
typed role order is not erased
at least one pairwise-indistinguishable world pair has a non-zero n-ary energy margin
eligibility receipt is sealed before outcome
training answer, verdict rationale and new lesson text are blocked from receiver prompts
rollback of learned W/H removes most measured gain
H, W, relation schema and embedding model are independently content-addressed
field merge and split identities do not depend on derived embedding caches
slow commit is blocked on degree, entropy, activation or edge-budget violation
embedding geometry parameters and outcome efficacy parameters are logged separately
fixed-routing numeric core passes a contraction margin or is reported only as bounded recurrent execution

worlds.pairwise_property: every unordered pair appears exactly once in each world
worlds.required_check: pairwise clique input digests are bit-identical

equal_compute: same input and output token budget
void_conditions: world identity leaks through tuple ids, prompt strings or candidate order
compute or information planes differ between arms
kill_criteria: pairwise baseline is within +/-2 percentage points of FULL_SWF
tensor shuffle preserves at least 50 percent of the full gain
gain disappears on fresh entity and relation paraphrases

implementation_sequence: SWF-0 role-aware CP score and local softmax on the existing immutable hypergraph
SWF-1 pre-outcome eligibility, independent outcome, numeric fast weights and rollback
SWF-2 product geometry only after M1 passes
SWF-3 frozen receiver transfer through version-pinned numeric W/H only
SWF-4 slow consolidation only after causal mediation passes
